access_boundary: This record represents the sonar-pro search line served through the Perplexity Sonar API. Perplexity ended Sonar Chat Completions support on September 27, 2026: synchronous and streaming requests are being reformulated as Agent API requests, rolling out by model, and the Agent API lists no sonar-pro model, only a migration mapping to its fast preset. The Pro Search mode is a parameter of this model, not a separate release. Other Sonar siblings, the Agent API presets, and the platform itself are separate boundaries.
strengths: Dedicated first-party page pins the model with 200K context and doubled search results
Pro Search mode and follow-up support on the first-party API
tradeoffs: No downloadable weights exist anywhere first-party for this model
The evergreen name carries no pinnable snapshot, and its API support ended on September 27, 2026 with no Agent API model to succeed it, only the fast preset
